how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stratholme-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

tokens.19: <Egan wipes a tear from his eye.>

rows.quest:5125:completion:0: ⟦1⟧, I am dying... but my soul is saved. For that, I owe you more than words can say. Please, take this... and fight on, brave ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:5212:obj:0: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from ⟦E1⟧ and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in ⟦E1⟧ would have said flesh sample.
rows.quest:5212:details:0: The ⟦E2⟧ apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences.
rows.quest:5212:details:1: BI have been studying the plague for years, ⟦3⟧. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the ⟦E3⟧ is startling. The plague seems to be growing in strength!
rows.quest:5212:details:2: BI need to run more tests! The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and bring me samples, ⟦4⟧.⟦5⟧
rows.quest:5212:completion:0: There is something that has changed in the chemical structure of the plague's active agents. More data is required.
rows.quest:5213:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.⟦6⟧
rows.quest:5213:details:0: You will have to delve deeper into ⟦E1⟧, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:5213:details:1: BBeyond the first gates you will find the ziggurats. We know that the Scourge draws great power from these structures. Search the Ziggurats and return with any information that you may discover.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:5213:completion:0: Astonishing! This will take months to dissect and analyze. The Argent Dawn thanks you for your efforts, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:5213:completion:1: BWith our blessing, take your pick between either this Seal of the Dawn or this Rune of the Dawn. You can use either of them instead of a standard Argent Dawn Commission to collect scourgestones on our behalf. Should you lose yours, speak with me and I'll get you a replacement.
rows.quest:5214:obj:0: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in ⟦E1⟧ and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:5214:details:0: Terrible thing... what happened to Fras. You see, the town was sacked and Fras didn't want to leave his precious goods behind. The last thing I remember him saying was, 'I'll burn every last leaf before they get their damned, dirty hands on them!'
rows.quest:5214:details:1: BI may love a good stogie but I'm no fool. I left Fras and his delightful store that day. I assume he went down in flames but if there's a chance that even one box of his famous tobacco is still intact...
rows.quest:5214:details:2: BWhat do you say, ⟦11⟧? Find a box for ol' Smokey?
rows.quest:5214:completion:0: Oh sweet, sweet stogie, how I have missed you...
rows.quest:5243:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 ⟦E1⟧ Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
rows.quest:5243:details:0: I look at my undeath as a malady, ⟦12⟧. An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead?
rows.quest:5243:details:1: BI am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me.
rows.quest:5243:details:2: BIf you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer.
rows.quest:5243:details:3: BVenture to ⟦E1⟧ and recover our surplus of holy water. Search the supply crates.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:5243:completion:0: Well done, ⟦14⟧. You have proven that while you are tolerant of others, you will stop at nothing to destroy the minions of Kel'Thuzad.
rows.quest:5251:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and find Archivist Galford of the ⟦E5⟧. Destroy him and burn down the ⟦E6⟧ Archive.
rows.quest:5251:details:0: Anything taken to an extreme is hazardous to our world, ⟦15⟧. Take for example, the ⟦E5⟧. Do you believe that their blind zealotry serves a greater good? How many innocents have they destroyed in the name of the Light?
rows.quest:5251:details:2: BOne in particular interests me, though; the Archivist Galford of ⟦E1⟧: A man that watches over the Crusade's most valued documents. Destroy him and burn down his archives! Should you succeed, return to me and be rewarded.
rows.quest:5251:completion:0: Outstanding, ⟦16⟧! Years of intelligence, lost! The ⟦E5⟧ will surely feel this blow in the coming weeks.
rows.quest:5262:obj:0: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5262:details:0: You try and gather your thoughts as the dust settles across the chamber. You go over the events that just transpired and still cannot comprehend the gravity of the situation.
rows.quest:5262:details:1: BThe Grand Crusader of the ⟦E5⟧ a demon? And not just any demon but brother to Varimathras, arch lord of the ⟦E8⟧?
rows.quest:5262:details:2: BYou carefully stow the severed head of the dreadlord into your pack. Surely, none would believe the tale you would tell without proof.
rows.quest:5262:details:3: BDuke Nicholas Zverenhoff must be told at once!
rows.quest:5262:completion:0: What will this mean to the Crusade? Could it be possible that they have been under the control of this demon? Unwittingly serving as the pawns to a greater evil?
rows.quest:5263:obj:0: Venture to ⟦E1⟧ and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.⟦17⟧
rows.quest:5263:details:0: You display a natural aptitude for destruction and you follow orders. It is rare to see the two coexist. I am beginning to think that you may make an excellent vehicle of divine justice.
rows.quest:5263:details:1: B<Zverenhoff clasps his hands together in front of his face.>
rows.quest:5263:details:2: BKel'Thuzad's errand boy rules over ⟦E1⟧. Prove to me that you are a champion - my champion. Destroy Baron Rivendare and return to me with his head. ⟦18⟧
rows.quest:5263:completion:0: It has been many years since I have ushered a champion into our ranks. You are the first to be granted audience with Lord Maxwell in years.
rows.quest:5282:obj:0: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of ⟦E1⟧. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
rows.quest:5282:obj:1: BFree 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
rows.quest:5282:details:0: I draw my power - my will to continue living and breathing - from the unmitigated hatred I have for the Scourge and all that they have done. I am, however, no zealot. There are those, like the ⟦E5⟧, who would sooner destroy the innocent undead than lend them even an ounce of compassion.
rows.quest:5282:details:1: BWhich brings me to this: My blaster. It will unchain the tortured souls from ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:5282:details:2: BUse it on the ghosts that haunt the ransacked streets. Free their souls.
rows.quest:5282:completion:1: BDid you see my mother, ⟦20⟧? Did you free her?
rows.quest:5282:completion:2: BYou are a shining example of decency. For your troubles...
rows.quest:5463:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
rows.quest:5463:details:0: I watched as the human, Ras Frostwhisper, pledged his undying soul to the Lich King. He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. The Lich King stood over the fallen mage and with a single motion, Ras Frostwhisper the lich, was born.
rows.quest:5463:details:1: B<Leonid gazes at the ground and then looks up at you.>
rows.quest:5463:details:2: BYes, ⟦21⟧, I remember. What you seek has a name - Menethil's Gift: The ground blessed by the Lich King - holy ground to Scourge.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:5463:completion:0: You place the keepsake on the tainted soil.
rows.quest:5848:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧, in the northern part of the ⟦E3⟧. It is in the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.
rows.quest:5848:obj:1: BReturn the painting to Tirion Fordring.
rows.quest:5848:details:0: The painting... It hung on the wall of my workshop - inside the Order's barracks - for years.
rows.quest:5848:details:1: BAfter Tirion's trial was over, I knew that I could no longer keep the painting visible. I hid it in a place that they would never think to look.
rows.quest:5848:details:2: BTravel to ⟦E1⟧ and make your way deep inside what is now the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion, search for a painting of our twin moons. Chip away at the paint until you uncover my master work, 'Of Love and Family.'
rows.quest:5848:details:3: BMay the Light guide your actions.
rows.quest:5848:completion:0: <Tirion nearly collapses when he sees the painting.>
rows.quest:5848:completion:1: B<He begins to sob in an almost frenetic manner.>
rows.quest:6163:obj:0: ⟦E4⟧ to ⟦E1⟧ and slay ⟦E9⟧. Take his head as a souvenir for ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:6163:details:0: I was overwhelmed. On this very stead, I stood... held my ground in defense of Lordaeron. The farm and all on it were waylaid by a gigantic wave of Scourge.
rows.quest:6163:details:1: BThe wretch. The filth. It hovered above me, entrails hanging from its gaping chest cavity.
rows.quest:6163:details:2: BI woke as Scourge. For so long I was helpless. My mind had coalesced with the Lich King's.
rows.quest:6163:details:3: BShe came for me... somewhere, somehow, I knew she would. Free.
rows.quest:6163:details:4: BAnd now, I must have my vengeance - my vengeance on that which took from me my life. Destroy it.
rows.quest:6163:completion:0: I wonder... did it beg for mercy? Could it know what mercy is?
rows.quest:6163:completion:2: BI will hang this beast's head upon my wall.
rows.quest:6163:completion:3: BYou have earned a spot amongst one of my champions, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:8945:obj:0: Go into ⟦E1⟧ and rescue Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
rows.quest:8945:details:0: I'll provide you the information you ask for, ⟦26⟧. But more pressing matters are at hand.
rows.quest:8945:details:1: BMy beloved wife has been taken prisoner by Rivendare's undead scum.
rows.quest:8945:details:2: BI strongly objected to her joining the Argent Dawn's foolish crusade, yet that's not of importance anymore. You must finish what I attempted to do, you must rescue Ysida from the clutches of the Baron!
rows.quest:8945:completion:0: Thank you for rescuing me... I feared for my life. Please accept this as a small token of my gratitude.
rows.quest:8945:completion:1: BAnthion is... no... he can't be...
rows.quest:8968:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8968:details:0: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the ⟦E5⟧ upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
rows.quest:8968:details:1: BFrom what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion.
rows.quest:8968:details:2: BIn any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
rows.quest:8968:completion:0: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and that is definitely a good thing!
rows.quest:8968:completion:1: BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8991:obj:0: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Jarien and Sothos and slay them. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
rows.quest:8991:details:0: The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, decided to join the ⟦E5⟧ upon the disbanding of our mercenary company. They took the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet with them. Good riddance, I say, but we need that piece back.
rows.quest:8991:details:1: BFrom what we could gather, they were actually slain by Grand Crusader Dathrohan himself for failing the initiation rites inside his chamber in the ⟦E6⟧ Bastion.
rows.quest:8991:details:2: BIn any case, we... meaning you, are still going to need to retrieve that piece of the amulet.
rows.quest:8991:completion:0: I suppose it's for the best that the souls of those two have finally been put to rest, even if I didn't like them while they were alive. In any case, we have what we were after, and now the amulet is reassembled! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8991:completion:1: BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
